rationale: Recommend the patched TensorFold 0.6 + EXL3 complete recipe for the measured one-Spark throughput profile, with bounded synthetic quality, context, mixed-request, API/tool and named-client checks on the final production image. The October 1 C1/C4 primary production run is the headline measurement; separate second-host replication is not pooled. Affine4 remains a practical alternative for cold long prefills. This does not isolate runtime or quantization causality, establish broad quality superiority, or claim one-Spark/two-Spark parity.

review.basis: Operator-authorized recommendation; production speed, quality, API/tool and named client gates were completed on the exact final image. Destination acceptance and operational endurance/reboot scope remain separate.

limitations: Throughput requests were all capped at 512 tokens and finish_reason length; they do not measure answer quality.
Reasoning and coding fixtures are bounded synthetic checks, not a broad quality benchmark.
The second native host is a separate build and run; results are not pooled.
Fresh destination acceptance, reboot recovery, and long-duration endurance remain untested.
No performance comparison establishes causal effects of runtime, weight format, or scheduling patches.
The GLM two-Spark recommendation is a separate model/workload and does not imply one-to-two Spark performance parity.
